lines: On another public story, outside TRIBE v2's training and evaluation sets (Paranoia, Finn et al. 2018; 22 listeners, the whole story: 1,250 volumes = 20.8 minutes at TR 1 s), stock TRIBE v2's forecast did not reach the bar in language areas (z -0.03, p = 0.66); it reached -0% of what the other listeners' average reaches. We show it because we said we would.
What it had to beat: word rate and the sound envelope (beaten in 1 of 4 comparisons).
